cohort: The study included 275 first-time mothers (178 pregnant primigravids >28 weeks and 97 first-time CS-delivered) from Adeoyo Maternity Teaching Hospital, Ibadan.
finding: Only a small proportion (13.45%) of participants had good knowledge of CS, perceptions varied, and attitudes were mixed, with knowledge significantly associated with educational level, occupation, religion, ethnicity, and family income.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (for primigravids >28 weeks) and post-delivery (for first-time CS-delivered mothers)
